''For a summary of all translated versions of The Wheel of Time see [[The Wheel of Time translations]].''

The Wheel of Time translates as ''A Roda do Tempo'' in Portuguese. It has been published both in Portugal and in Brazil. In Portugal, it the series has been published by Bertrand up until [[Lord of Chaos]] (2023) with forthcoming volumes currently being translated. In Brazil, the series has been published by Intrínseca up until [[The Path of Daggers]] (2022) with similarly forthcoming volumes. The first two books were also published by Caladwin.

The translators for the Brazilian versions so far are Fábio Fernandes (TEOTW, TGH), Donaldson Garschagen (TGH), Julia Henriques (TGH), Mariana Serpa Vollmer (TDR, TSH, LOC, ACOS) and Rafael Miranda Rodrigues (TFOH, LOC, ACOS).
